findings.evidence: Basic.lean:50 defines `zMoment`; the PR adds `zMoment_comap` (Basic.lean:177) and `zMoment_partonConj` (Symmetries.lean:135). Grep for `zMoment` in Symmetries.lean returns only `zMoment_partonConj`; grep for `zMoment_congr` over EpsilonEridani/ returns nothing, while `mellinMoment_congr` exists for `Pdf`.
findings.fix: Add `zMoment_favored`/`zMoment_unfavored` on a valence flavour (`zMoment (favored valence D) n h i Q2 = zMoment D n h (Species.quark i) Q2` under `IsValenceFlavor` plus the quark/antiquark orientation), mirroring `zMoment_partonConj`; or add a `zMoment_congr` in `Fragmentation/Basic.lean` next to `zMoment_comap`, analogous to `PDF.mellinMoment_congr` (PDF/Basic.lean:160).
findings.issue: `Assumptions.favored`/`Assumptions.unfavored` (192, 199) declare the combinations to be fragmentation families, but no lemma connects `favored`/`unfavored` to `zMoment`, and `Fragmentation` has no `zMoment_congr`; since `favored`'s body is unexposed, a consumer cannot reach moment space at all without redoing the integral congruence by hand.

findings.evidence: Symmetries.lean:153 `def favored`, :166 `favored_def` (no attribute), :463–519 the ten lemmas (no attribute); ValenceContent.lean:255,259,264 `@[simp] Pion.valence_*`.
findings.fix: Mark the ten `favored_pion_*`/`unfavored_pion_*` lemmas `@[simp]`; they are strictly simplifying and cannot loop.
findings.issue: None of the ten pion evaluation lemmas carries `@[simp]` (463, 469, 475, 481, 487, 493, 499, 505, 511, 517), although each rewrites `favored/unfavored Pion.valence D ...` to a single `D` application and is the only way to evaluate it: `favored_def` is not simp and the body is not exposed (`public section`, no `@[expose]`, line 85). `Pion.valence_plus/zero/minus` are simp, so a consumer's `simp` makes no progress on a `favored` goal.

findings.evidence: Species.lean:194 `def flavorPair` under `public section` (line 51, no `@[expose]`), :197 `flavorPair_def` unannotated, :207/:214 the two image lemmas unannotated while :201 `mem_flavorPair` is `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Mark `image_conj_flavorPair` and `image_map_flavorPair` `@[simp]`; both have strictly simpler right-hand sides (`flavorPair i`, `flavorPair (ρ i)`) and cannot loop.
findings.issue: `image_conj_flavorPair` (207) and `image_map_flavorPair` (214) are the only public handles on `(flavorPair i).image conj` / `.image (map ρ)` — `flavorPair`'s body is unexposed and `flavorPair_def` is not simp — yet neither is `@[simp]`, so these normal-form rewrites must be applied by hand downstream (as in Symmetries.lean:349, 370 and ValenceContent.lean:154, 162).

summary: The characteristic API for `favored`/`unfavored`, `Invariant` and `Species.map`/`flavorPair` is otherwise complete and the three prior findings are fixed, but the combinations have no interaction with `zMoment` (the only analytic operation on `Frag`), and several characteristic lemmas that are the sole unfolding-free entry points carry no `@[simp]`.
